mapper.select: SELECT auction_window_id, last_decision_id, last_decision_version, last_kafka_topic, last_kafka_partition, last_kafka_offset FROM promotion_projection_checkpoint WHERE auction_window_id = #{auctionWindowId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO promotion_projection_checkpoint ( auction_window_id, last_decision_id, last_decision_version, last_kafka_topic, last_kafka_partition, last_kafka_offset, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{auctionWindowId}, #{lastDecisionId}, #{lastDecisionVersion}, #{lastKafkaTopic}, #{lastKafkaPartition}, #{lastKafkaOffset}, NOW(3) ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_decision_id = VALUES(last_decision_id), last_decision_version = VALUES(last_decision_version), last_kafka_topic = COALESCE(VALUES(last_kafka_topic), last_kafka_topic), last_kafka_partition = COALESCE(VALUES(last_kafka_partition), last_kafka_partition), last_kafka_offset = COALESCE(VALUES(last_kafka_offset), last_kafka_offset), updated_at = NOW(3)
